message: 赤チンに乾杯！

name: Misa
message: 「Sorry for making you tag along.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, I was just wanting to go out for a walk anyway.」
Misa and I are heading to Asukai Shrine together.
Apparently, Shio-chan got her hands on a valuable book and asked Misa to appraise it.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, I know you're a bookworm and all, Misa, but wouldn't it be better to ask Melilot-san about books?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's, um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you blushing?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, why do you always ask things so bluntly!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are those cheeks, like the finest marshmallows, dyeing crimson like apples just beginning to ripen?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Rephrasing it with metaphors doesn't make it okay!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, what a hopeless guy. Still, this is a golden opportunity!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you read the rare book Shio acquired, even you might understand a maiden's heart and learn some delicacy, Sakura-kun.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Big Sister and Synn-dono. I have been awaiting your arrival.」

name: Misa
message: 「I came to hang out, Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「It has been quite some time since you last graced our household with your presence.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh come on, I literally just stayed the night the other day.」

name: Shio
message: 「I would have you stay for many nights, Big Sister. Why not take up lodging at our residence altogether?」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Umm. That's a tempting offer, but... I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you come here often, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course. My family and Shio's family have been close for generations.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Thanks to Big Sister, I am able to preserve my maiden's heart even amidst my grueling training.」

name: Shio
message: 「In particular, 'Rainbow Love Rhapsody' and 'Cheers to a Cherry Kiss,' which I received from Big Sister, are my greatest treasures.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey, Shio! What are you saying in front of Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it...?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fine that you don't!!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I've seen a rainbow before so I know what that is, right? It's just that I can't picture a cherry.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a pretty major fruit, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. Doesn't the word 'fruit' basically just mean bananas?」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bananas when splurging, pineapples for an extravagant stretch, and grapes when taking the ultimate plunge. Only those three kinds of fruit exist in my world.」

name: Misa
message: 「B-Boys living on their own are...」

name: Misa
message: 「Gah!? No, no, I didn't come here to talk about such domestic things... Shio!」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood! You mean that matter, correct?」

name: Shio
message: 「Allow me to apologize in advance. The rare book was merely a pretext to summon you here, Elder Sister. In truth, I have another personal errand to attend to...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「For Shio-chan to pull a stunt like that, what on earth happened?」

name: Misa
message: 「We're practically sisters. Please, talk to me about anything.」

name: Shio
message: 「Well... embarrassing as it is to admit...」

name: Misa
message: 「Spit it out!」

name: Shio
message: 「V-Very well... I shall take the plunge and say it.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! Jiiya-dono is... nay, Big Sister Riesling belongs to me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister is supposed to be devoted solely to Sir Senpai. I humbly implore you to refrain from making any moves on Sir Riesling!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmph, the blood of yuri, eh...」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Umm... just who is Shio talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, Lolotte's butler and bodyguard--」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, Mr. Rodriguez Satou.」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyan!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Riesling-san, what are you doing here?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I was purchasing magic bullets at the junk shop in the sacred grove.」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Such a blatantly suspicious shop at Asukai Shrine!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, excuse me. Please continue to take good care of my lady.」
Riesling-san gives a light bow and walks away down the shrine approach.

name: Shio
message: 「Ahh, completely erasing her presence to close in behind Elder Sister... Movements without a single opening. I am utterly enchanted!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, Riesling-san doesn't make any footsteps, does she?」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhin♪ She even bows properly beneath the torii gate. What a magnificent person she is.\s04」

name: Shio
message: 「When I gaze upon Big Sister Riesling, my heart won't stop pounding, and my cheeks grow hot as if with a slight fever.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「This girl is your little sister, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「...She's your junior.」

name: Shio
message: 「I, too, wish to reach the same realm of mastery as Big Sister. First, starting with training to silence my footsteps--」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ugh... How pathetic, how unsightly!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, stop right there!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister?」

name: Misa
message: 「Stay still right there and roll up the right leg of your hakama!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Careless of me! To think she saw right through it...!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong, Shio?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio hurt her right leg. Her gait was different from usual, wasn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, good eye catching that. Even though she was walkin' all weird so she wouldn't make footsteps.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Ummm... Since it's a girl's thigh, I shouldn't be looking, right? I'll go pray at the Inari shrine or something.」

name: Shio
message: 「No, 'tis merely a scrape on my right knee. I care not if such a thing is seen.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-S-S-Sakura-kun, you pervert! Why are you specifically narrowing it down to thighs?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... W-Well, that's...」
While I was at a loss for an answer, Misa pulled a small first-aid kit from her pocket and deftly began tending to Shio-chan.
A scraped kneecap. An injury everyone gets at least once as a kid.

name: Shio
message: 「Synn-dono, did you know? My elder sister also keeps a sewing kit in her pocket at all times.」

name: Shio
message: 「Such is how a maiden ought to be, wouldn't you say.」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, don't change the subject!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, hey now! What is this wound, you just lazily rinsed it with water, didn't you.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's no good at all. I'm always telling you to disinfect your injuries when you get hurt, aren't I!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I have no excuse to offer.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio isn't afraid of getting hurt, but she's terrible at actually looking at her wounds. Honestly, she's such a child.」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please do not expose my secret~...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, brace yourself, because I'm disinfecting it.」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhii... Even I possess a sense of shame befitting my age. Anything but the mercurochrome!」

name: Synn
message: 「Heeh, so I actually get to witness the rare sight of Misa being caring.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! The 'rare' part was completely unnecessary.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, Synn-dono, it seems you still do not truly understand my elder sister.」

name: Shio
message: 「Despite how she looks, she possesses a ruthless side as merciless as a Demon Lord, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa as a Demon Lord, huh... Doesn't sound too bad.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's the absolute worst!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, it was truly awful!」

name: Shio
message: 「When I left a wound unattended because I hated disinfecting it, my elder sister snapped.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lo and behold, she doodled Blackuma on my skin using mercurochrome! There are limits to cruelty!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What a pathetic Demon Lord...」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's all in the past! Don't go running your mouth in front of Sakura-kun!」

name: Shio
message: 「Mmph-mmph!」
Misa covers Shio-chan's mouth.

name: Misa
message: 「Oh?」
Misa tilts her head slightly and moves her hand to Shio-chan's forehead.

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, you're burning up with a fever!」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm? I cannot say I feel any different... *cough, hack*!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I have just now become aware of it.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're coming down with a cold! You've been out hunting Demons late every single night, haven't you!?」

name: Shio
message: 「If such is the pride of the Asukai house! Even should this body crumble to dust, I shall halt the rampage of those fiends.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, you can't do that--」

name: Shio
message: 「Or so I believed, right up until yesterday.」

name: Shio
message: 「Late last night, when I had collapsed from exhaustion, Lady Riesling happened to pass by and tended to me...」

name: Shio
message: 「At that time, she bestowed upon me some words of wisdom.」

name: Shio
message: 「That I ought first to devote myself to reaching a state where I can gauge the limits of my own strength. Demonstrating a spirit of self-sacrifice can wait until after that--」

name: Shio
message: 「She is a truly noble soul.」

name: Shio
message: 「As I gazed upon Lady Riesling, my heart began to pound, my cheeks flushed red, my head grew dizzy, and my throat became parched.」

name: Shio
message: 「This must undoubtedly be my first love!!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Aren't those literally just the early symptoms of a cold?」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-Whaaaat did you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, don't tell me... you met Riesling-san in that condition and mistook your fever for falling in love?」

name: Shio
message: 「Th-That cannot possibly be! Sister, would you truly deny my first love!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, naginata squirt. Do you feel anything when you look at yours truly?」

name: Shio
message: 「When I stare closely at a monster... my heart rate does indeed quicken.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, what about me?」

name: Shio
message: 「My head feels all fuzzy, and I cannot gather my thoughts.」

name: Misa
message: 「Try looking into my eyes.」

name: Shio
message: 「When I look at you, Sister... m-my face starts burning up...」

name: Shio
message: 「Nnggh...」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How careless! To think that someone of my caliber would jump to such a conclusion!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew, good grief.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, take the day off from your duties today. Do you have cold medicine at home? Make sure you go to bed early tonight. Understood?」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Your will be done.」

name: Shio
message: 「It feels somewhat disappointing, but from now on, I shall respect Jiiya-dono as a fellow martial artist.」

name: Shio
message: 「To be honest, I am relieved to find out it was merely a cold.」

name: Shio
message: 「I was bewildered, thinking I had fallen for someone of the same sex. Confusing romance with admiration and harboring feelings for a senior on the same path--utter folly!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-How rude! The love between my big sister and me is far purer than that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, nobody asked about that, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, we still haven't disinfected your wound. Brace yourself!」

name: Shio
message: 「Gyaaaah. ...I-It stings~!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, how many years has it been since Shio got an injury like this?」

name: Shio
message: 「The cold was part of it, yes, but my mind was in turmoil during training... It seems I am still quite green.」

name: Shio
message: 「The contents of that book were simply too shocking...」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? Wha? You actually got your hands on that!? That out-of-print 'Everything About Kissing', right!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Girls love kissing, after all. I don't have any experience myself, but did reading it give you that bittersweet, fluttering feeling?」

name: Shio
message: 「It was a book about sushi. *Drip*」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, a tear fell.」

name: Misa
message: 「...*Drip, drip, drip*」

name: Paqy
message: 「What is up with this cousin of ours!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't ask me.」
